patterns.build_workflow: One build at a time, inspect output, fix warnings
patterns.completion_criteria: Build succeeded ≠ works correctly, evaluate against spec
patterns.memory_persistence: Write to files, mental notes don't survive
patterns.skill_activation: Load on-demand based on task context

preferences.documentation: Self-documenting code + inline comments for tricky logic
preferences.permission_style: Act when confident, explain when stuck (never ask 'should I start?')
preferences.research_timeframe: 2025-2026 only, never use 2024 or older data
preferences.quality_bar: Match the production bar documented in the workspace
preferences.team_deployment: Use subagents for parallel research and multiple perspectives

completion_criteria.functionality_verified: Tested against spec, not just compiled
completion_criteria.quality_matches_live: Comparable to the production bar documented in the workspace
completion_criteria.grounded_research: All patterns verified against 2025/2026 official docs
